messages.subject: midterm evaluations
parts:
Dear all,

please fill in the midterm evaluations - deadline is Friday and missing
evaluations are counted as fail by Google. This applies to students as
well as to mentors.

Each project needs to have one student and at least one mentor
evaluation. Google now allows for more than one official mentor per
student, so I entered the co-mentors: Co-mentors should be able to do
the evaluation as well.

If you cannot access the evaluation form (table evaluations on the
dashboard) please let us admins know.
So far, we can see that about half of the projects have the mentor
evaluations submitted already - thank you!
We cannot see whether the students submitted their evaluations.

Best,

Claudia
